name: library-brain

scripts.build: bun run assets && bun run brain && sh scripts/swap.sh
scripts.brain: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with numpy --with umap-learn python scripts/brain.py

description: Books as a static site with a brain: every passage embedded on the Apple Neural Engine at build time, a 3D meaning map, search by meaning, and an MCP over the prebuilt vectors.
